messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Re: Heatmap of DMRs in methylKit
parts:
Hi,
You can try to look at the script on this link:
 https://github.com/exa564/HSCe_Aging

Essentially you have to save a bed file with your DMCs (3 columns: chr start end), a file with your DMRs and a perc.meth.txt file with percent methylation for each sample for each CpG.
You can get and save a txt from your perc.meth file after performing the unite on methylkit:
meth=unite(norm_myobj, destrand=TRUE)
perc.meth <- percMethylation(meth, rowids = TRUE)
